args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities (Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay, Kailua Beach):
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Water shoes
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

Hiking & Outdoor Activities (Diamond Head, North Shore):
- Comfortable hiking shoes/boots
- Lightweight, moisture-wicking clothing
- Rain jacket/light windbreaker
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

Evening & Special Events (Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center):
- Casual but nice outfits
- Light sweater or jacket for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Dress or aloha shirt for luau

General Clothing:
- Lightweight, breathable clothing (t-shirts, shorts, sundresses)
- Undergarments
- Sleepwear
- Socks
- Flip-flops/sandals
- One outfit for shopping day at Ala Moana Center

Electronics & Accessories:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Headphones

Personal Items:
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Medications
- Hairbrush/comb
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for relaxation day
- Travel pillow for flights
- Reusable shopping bags
- Small umbrella
- Notebook and pen

Notes:
- Pack light as laundry facilities are available at most hotels
- Most items can be purchased in Hawaii if forgotten
- Consider the activities planned each day when packing daily outfits
